details: Japan's Lower House passed a bill on June 11, 2026, that reclassifies digital assets as financial instruments. This legislation aims to reduce the capital gains tax on crypto from a potential maximum of 55% to a flat 20%. The move is anticipated to facilitate the listing of crypto Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) by 2027, with the new tax rate slated for implementation in 2028.
title: Japan Advances Crypto Tax Reform, Eyes ETFs

details: Ethereum spot ETFs recorded $8.65 million in net inflows on June 11, 2026, primarily driven by contributions from BlackRock's funds. This inflow comes after BitMine Immersion Technologies made its largest Ether purchase of the year, acquiring 126,971 ETH for approximately $214 million during a recent market dip (reported June 9, 2026).
sourceName: Phemex (for ETF inflows), TradingView News (for BitMine purchase)
title: Ethereum Spot ETFs Attract Inflows; BitMine Makes Large ETH Purchase

details: XRP experienced a 3% surge on June 12, 2026, breaking above the $1.14 mark. This upward movement is attributed to intensified institutional buying, marking one of the strongest hourly buying sessions in recent weeks. Despite the rally, XRP continues to trade below a broader descending trendline.
title: XRP Surges 3% on Institutional Buying

details: Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, minted 1 billion USDC on the Solana blockchain within a 24-hour period, as reported on June 12, 2026. This issuance contributes to Circle's total of 57 billion USDC issued in 2026, underscoring Solana's increasing significance in the stablecoin ecosystem.
title: Circle Mints 1 Billion USDC on Solana
